 About the match
 On this page you can find the Al Hilal vs Al Hazem match lineup for Saudi Pro League — Round 10 - First Leg, on Monday 19-10-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Al Hilal lines up in a 4-1-4-1 led by Kanno, while Al Hazem sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Al-Dakheel. Al Hilal is led by head coach Simone Inzaghi, while Al Hazem is managed by Jalel Kadri. The match is played at Kingdom Arena.
